text:
nora: New hire hit a weird auth break while rotating creds in the onboarding lab. They replaced REDWOOD_API_KEY but got immediate 401s from sampleapp.
bjorn: Any error text?
nora: Just `401 Unauthorized` in the app logs. No helpful hint.
lex: Do we know the envs the new hire had set?
nora: They had REDWOOD_API_KEY=newkey, REDWOOD_ORG=acme, but REDWOOD_PROJECT was missing. The key they got is project-scoped.
tara: Right, project-scoped keys require project to be set. We have a parity problem: some SDKs read REDWOOD_PROJECT, others accept REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME, CLI accepts --project.
bjorn: That mismatch can make a rotated key suddenly look invalid. If the app reads the wrong var name it doesn't send project scope and server rejects.
lex: Two immediate fixes: 1) sampleapp should validate at startup and error with a clear hint if API key present but no project env detected. 2) SDKs should temporarily accept both env names and prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT.
tara: Also the retry behavior: our HTTP client treats 401 as retryable in some SDKs, leading to long spinning retries during rotation windows. We should treat 401/403 as non-retry unless server provides Retry-After or `x-redwood-retryable-auth: true`.
ci-watch: CI: onboarding-smoke job queued to run sampleapp with only REDWOOD_API_KEY set.
nora: Good. I'll update sampleapp README and add the startup check (`if api_key and not project -> exit 1 with message`).
bjorn: I'll open parity PRs for Node/Java/Python to accept env fallback and add unit tests that simulate env var permutations.
lex: For the retry change, make a small auth error class so callers can decide no-retry by default. Add a log hint: "Missing project scope? set REDWOOD_PROJECT or pass --project".
tara: Can we also add a server header like `x-redwood-expected-scope: project` when rejecting for scope mismatch? That will make debugging immediate.
nora: I'll file a backend ticket for that. Ops: run the CI smoke job and let us know if it catches anything.
ci-watch: CI: onboarding-smoke #901 started
bjorn: Timeline: README & onboarding doc patch today, SDK parity + tests in next patch release. We'll include CHANGES note.
ora: Thanks team. Follow-ups: PR links, onboarding doc update, backend header ticket.
